high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the user "richertoday." The post is part of a series, as indicated by the number "4/9" in the top right corner, suggesting it is the fourth installment in a nine-part series. Content of the Post: The main topic of the post is about drugs, specifically opium and heroin. It states that Afghanistan produces 85% of the world's opium, which is the major ingredient for heroin. It mentions that the Taliban controlled a majority of the opium farms in Afghanistan.
